For Thesis: Personality-Rate Linear Models

Here, we carry out linear models for our PCA scores.

Preparing world environment

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(ggeffects)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

pca_scores <- read.csv("~/Savolainen Lab/SSB/Data/Personality/pca_scores_rankrate.csv")

# removing NA values
pca_scores <- pca_scores %>% 
  drop_na(
  DS)

Adding group and year, so they can be used

year <- read.csv("~/Savolainen Lab/SSB/Data/Personality/Updated_Chloe/focals_used_forrank.csv") %>% 
  rename(Animal_ID = ID)

group <- read.csv("~/Savolainen Lab/SSB/Data/Rank/rank_all_personality.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(c("Animal_ID", "Group"))

pca_scores <- left_join(pca_scores, year, by = "Animal_ID")
pca_scores <- left_join(pca_scores, group, by = "Animal_ID")

Removing duplicate rows

pca_scores <- pca_scores %>%
  dplyr::select(-X) %>%     # Remove the unnecessary row-number column
  distinct(Animal_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

Linear Models:

Making sure all values are numeric and factors as factors

pca_scores <- pca_scores %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(RC1,
      RC2,
      RC3,
      DS,
      DS_norm,
      adjusted_SSB,
      adjusted_SSB_giver,
      adjusted_SSB_receiver,
      age_years),
    as.numeric
  ))

pca_scores <- pca_scores %>% 
  mutate(across(
    c(Year,
      Group),
    as.factor)
  )

Dominance Rank ~ RC1 (Social Confidence)

lm_rc1 <- lm(RC1 ~ DS + age_years + Group + Year, data = pca_scores)
summary(lm_rc1)

Plotting linear models of dominance rank on personality effects

Finding y-axis scale

pred_rc1 <- predict_response(
  lm_rc1,
  terms = "DS",
  margin = "empirical"
)
Package `marginaleffects` required for this function to work.
y
trying URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/macosx/big-sur-arm64/contrib/4.5/marginaleffects_0.32.0.tgz'
Content type 'application/x-gzip' length 2268855 bytes (2.2 MB)
==================================================
downloaded 2.2 MB

The downloaded binary packages are in
    /var/folders/hm/m1vxxms91sv3lsvjp0392mg80000gn/T//Rtmpf0AFI8/downloaded_packages
pred_rc2_int <- predict_response(
  lm_rc2_int,
  terms = c("DS", "Group"),
  margin = "empirical"
)

pred_rc3 <- predict_response(
  lm_rc3, 
  terms = "DS",
  margin = "empirical"
)

y_lim <- range(
  pca_scores$RC1,
  pca_scores$RC2,
  pca_scores$RC3,
  pred_rc1$conf.low,
  pred_rc1$conf.high,
  pred_rc2_int$conf.low,
  pred_rc2_int$conf.high,
  pred_rc3$conf.low,
  pred_rc3$conf.high,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

x_lim <- range(pca_scores$DS, na.rm = TRUE)

theme_personality <-
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 17
    ),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.22, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 17
    ),
    plot.tag = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

RC1

p_rc1 <-
  ggplot(
    pca_scores,
    aes(DS, RC1)
  ) +

  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.65,
    size = 3
  ) +

  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_rc1,
    aes(
      x = x,
      ymin = conf.low,
      ymax = conf.high
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.08,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data = pred_rc1,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = predicted
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 2
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = x_lim
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = y_lim
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Social Confidence"
  ) +

  theme_personality

p_rc1

RC2

p_rc2_int <- ggplot(pca_scores,
                    aes(DS, RC2)) +

  # Observed data
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = Group),
    alpha = 0.65,
    size = 3
  ) +

  # 95% confidence intervals
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_rc2_int,
    aes(
      x = x,
      ymin = conf.low,
      ymax = conf.high,
      fill = group,
      group = group
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.08,
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Predicted lines
  geom_line(
    data = pred_rc2_int,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = predicted,
      colour = group
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 2.0
  ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
    limits = x_lim
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = y_lim
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    R = "#D55E00",
    V = "#0072B2"
  )) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    R = "#D55E00",
    V = "#0072B2"
  )) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Assertiveness",
    colour = "Group"
  ) +

theme_personality

p_rc2_int

  plot = p_rc3,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)

Combining all three

combined_plot <-
  (
    (p_rc1 +
       theme(
         legend.position = "none"
       )) /

    (p_rc2_int +
       theme(
         legend.position = "top",
         legend.justification = "center"
       ) +
       guides(
         colour = guide_legend(
           override.aes = list(
             shape = 20,
             size = 5,
             linewidth = 2.8
           )
         ),
         fill = "none"
       )) /

    (p_rc3 +
       theme(
         legend.position = "none"
       ))
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A"
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

combined_plot

ggsave(
  filename = "~/Savolainen Lab/Figures/RC1_RC2_RC3_combined_new.tiff",
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 600
)
